html:
Welcome to Chrono Space 7: an isometric twin stick shooter adventure where you’ll fight waves of enemies in space. Ships and monsters will attack you, and you must defeat them in order to advance using your different skills and leveling up to advance through dioramas in a moving galaxy and become stronger, with the final goal being to end the threat that inhabits the center of the galaxy.

Save the galaxy:

Throughout your adventure, you can decide whether or not to help defend the different planets, which are under heavy attack by numerous waves of enemies, thus getting large amounts of experience to level up. Are you up to the challenge?
